create_Benchmarker: create a Benchmarker instance with metric updates dictionary to benchmark a model during test loop
test_Benchmarker: test the Benchmarker class by running benchmarker.test(model, dataloader) to compute metrics automatically
run_Benchmarker_compute_metrics: run benchmarker.compute_metrics() to get all provided metrics as a dictionary of Python values
build_Benchmarker: build a Benchmarker with metric updates to perform benchmarking loop using PyTorch Lightning Trainer
review_Benchmarker__to_python: review the Benchmarker._to_python static method that converts torch tensors and iterables to Python types
